# energy-node Icons — Icon set reference

This integration provides eighteen device symbols from the energy-node dashboard plus a generic fallback icon. Each icon is an outline that Home Assistant fills with your chosen theme color.

The icons are drawn from the device catalogue and used throughout the dashboard's device cards and device modal to represent batteries, solar panels, grid connections, heat pumps, meters, and infrastructure.
